scripts.devspace: echo '📱 Development Disk Usage:' && du -sh ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData 2>/dev/null || echo '   Not found' && echo '🦀 Cargo:' && du -sh ~/.cargo 2>/dev/null || echo '   Not found' && echo '📦 NPM:' && du -sh ~/.npm 2>/dev/null || echo '   Not found' && echo '💾 Available:' && df -h /System/Volumes/Data | tail -1 | awk '{print "   " $4 " free (" int($5) "% used)"}'
scripts.build:ios:sim: echo '🧹 Quick cleanup...' && npm run cleanup && echo '📱 Building iOS...' && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 bun tauri ios dev "iPhone 16 Pro"
scripts.build:ios: echo '🧹 Quick cleanup...' && npm run cleanup && echo '📱 Building iOS...' && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 bun tauri ios dev
